description: Regression: a board quick-assign whose ASSIGN_TARGET actions are REJECTED must not crash the engine. _on_quick_assign_all_to_target walks live TreeItems; emitting inside that walk let a rejection handler rebuild (and free) the tree under the iterator, dereferenced on the next get_next() -> SIGSEGV. The tutorial gate is used here as a convenient always-reject source, but any rejection (multiplayer, validate/execute divergence) hits the same path. Passing means the engine survived and the assignments were correctly refused.

steps.comment: the single-eligible-target auto-assign has run, so the tree has assigned rows to walk
clear so the quick-assign below has every weapon to (re)assign
arm the gate so every ASSIGN_TARGET this quick-assign emits is rejected
THE REPRO: walks every weapon TreeItem, emitting an assign per row that the gate rejects

steps.script:
TutorialManager.active = false
TutorialManager._steps = []
TutorialManager.current_step_index = -1
return true

steps.comment: every assign was refused, so the phase holds none of them
reaching this step at all is the real assertion: the engine did not segfault mid-walk
